intro.sr: Klijent kupuje bez ikakve registracije: bira proizvod u prodavnici, upisuje podatke na naplati, a sistem sam pravi nalog u pozadini. Pokazane su dve kupovine (druga sa kuponom) - svaka sa novim gostom, pa se automatsko pravljenje naloga dešava oba puta. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: A customer buys with no registration at all: picks a product in the shop, enters their details at checkout and the system creates an account in the background. Two purchases are shown (the second with a coupon) - each with a new guest, so the automatic account creation happens both times. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
